ai.title: Add Windows floor-only sponsored execution gating
ai.summary: A new `common/src/ads/sponsored-windows.ts` module gates generic agentic Windows serving behind two opt-ins: `FREEBUFF_SPONSORED_WINDOWS` (only the exact value `on` opens) and `FREEBUFF_SPONSORED_WINDOWS_CAMPAIGN_IDS` (a comma-separated list of reviewed campaign UUIDs). Because Windows has no OS sandbox under a sponsored run, admitted runs carry `SPONSORED_WINDOWS_CONTAINMENT` ('floor') instead of a sandbox, and `SponsoredComputeGrant` now exposes optional `executionSurface` and containment so the funded Accept route can select the floor-only broker only on `desktop_windows`. The Supabase format and its CPC experiment arms deliberately stay macOS/Linux: `desktop_windows` is refused by name in `supabaseFoundationStackEligible` and in both `SUPABASE_FORMAT_CPC_ARM_REACH` arms, so Windows only ever reaches generic campaigns the operator reviewed.
ai.evidence: New file `common/src/ads/sponsored-windows.ts` adds `readSponsoredWindowsPolicy`, `sponsoredWindowsAdmitsCampaign`, `sponsoredExecutionContainment`, and `sponsoredDesktopSurfaceMatchesOs`, reading env vars `FREEBUFF_SPONSORED_WINDOWS` and `FREEBUFF_SPONSORED_WINDOWS_CAMPAIGN_IDS`; `common/src/ads/sponsored-compute-contract.ts` imports `SPONSORED_WINDOWS_EXECUTION_SURFACE` and `SponsoredExecutionContainment` to add optional `executionSurface` and containment fields to `SponsoredComputeGrant`; tests assert `readSponsoredWindowsPolicy` fails closed on absent/typed-off/garbage values and admits only listed UUIDs.
ai.migration: Operators who want to offer Windows generic agentic runs must set `FREEBUFF_SPONSORED_WINDOWS` to `on` and `FREEBUFF_SPONSORED_WINDOWS_CAMPAIGN_IDS` to a comma-separated list of reviewed campaign UUIDs; any other value or malformed list closes Windows serving.

facts: The error listener must attach in the same tick as spawn (hence the callback, not a promise of the child): a child that fails to start emits 'error' on the next tick, and with no listener yet that is an unhandled error event.

ai.title: SDK git changes spawn now catches synchronous throw
ai.summary: The `gitOutput` helper in `getGitChanges` now routes every `spawn` call (both `git` and `gh`) through a new `spawnSafely` wrapper that performs the spawn inside a try/catch and rejects via `Promise.reject` on a synchronous throw. On Windows, when `git` resolves to a `.cmd`/`.bat` shim, an argument carrying a cmd.exe special character such as the `%` in `--format=%aN%x09%aE%x09%cs%x09%s` is refused synchronously by spawn before any child exists, which previously skipped every `.catch` and failed the whole turn on every prompt; this wrapper lets the existing `.catch` handlers degrade to a missing field instead. The error listener still attaches in the same tick as spawn because a child that fails to start emits `error` on the next tick, and the `consume` callback receives the child so `childProcessToPromise` can observe its pipes and close event normally.
ai.evidence: The diff adds a new `spawnSafely` wrapper in `getGitChanges` within `sdk/src/run-state.ts` that wraps `spawn` calls for `git` and `gh` in a try/catch so synchronous throws (e.g., Windows .cmd git shim rejecting `%` in `--format`) are caught instead of crashing the turn, and routes all children through it.
ai.unknowns: The diff does not show whether all call sites that construct git commands outside `getGitChanges` have received equivalent treatment, or which release ships this fix.

ai.title: Agentic offer route wire contract defined for COD-665
ai.summary: A new module `common/src/ads/agentic-offer.ts` defines the Zod wire contract for the agentic offer route (COD-665), exposing `AGENTIC_OFFER_PATH` ('/api/v1/ads/agentic/offer') and `AGENTIC_OFFER_ROUTE_VERSION` (1) along with `agenticOfferRequestSchema`, `agenticOfferResponseSchema`, and the closed `AGENTIC_OFFER_NONE_REASONS` ('disabled', 'ineligible_client', 'not_tier1', 'no_match', 'suppressed', 'deadline', 'error'). The contract moves agentic card decisions out of the `/api/ads` display request into a dedicated per-user-turn endpoint, with a reversible cutover gated by the `FREEBUFF_AGENTIC_POOL` server knob gaining a third value `route`, where an updated Desktop client sends `agenticOfferRoute: 1` and `/api/ads` skips agentic discovery. Response objects are intentionally not `.strict()`, so the server may add fields without a version bump while an older client simply drops them.
ai.evidence: New file `common/src/ads/agentic-offer.ts` defines `AGENTIC_OFFER_PATH = '/api/v1/ads/agentic/offer'`, `AGENTIC_OFFER_ROUTE_VERSION = 1`, plus `agenticOfferRequestSchema`, `agenticOfferResponseSchema`, and `AGENTIC_OFFER_NONE_REASONS` as the wire contract for the agentic offer route (COD-665), with a cutover comment tying it to the `FREEBUFF_AGENTIC_POOL` server knob gaining a third value `route`.
ai.unknowns: The diff defines the contract only; it does not show the server-side reader of `FREEBUFF_AGENTIC_POOL=route`, the Freebuff Desktop client sender of `agenticOfferRoute: 1`, or the handler exposing `POST /api/v1/ads/agentic/offer` on freebuff-web.
